_comment: The key manifest. One entry per API key Agent OS can use.
You never edit this file. You store keys with ./vault.sh --set or ./keys.sh --setup,
then ./keys.sh --apply fans each value out to the scattered locations below.
Every destination carries an evidence field citing the file and line the claim came
from, verified against the agent-os-pack-2026-08-16 source. Pack versions move, so
run ./keys.sh --discover after an update to confirm nothing has changed.
formats: env = KEY=value line | json = named field in a JSON config |
env-only = read from the process environment, no file is consulted.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is deliberately absent and is blocked by keys.sh. The Claude tab
uses claude login. An empty value in a .env.local silently overrides that login and
is the single most common Claude tab failure.

tiers.core: Set these. They unlock the spine of the system.
tiers.useful: Cheap and genuinely additive for most people.
tiers.optional: Only if you will actually use that tab.
tiers.skip: Something you almost certainly already own a better version of.

keys.label: OpenRouter
keys.cost_detail: Many models are free. With no credit you get 50 requests/day. $5 of credit once raises that to 1,000/day while still using free models.
keys.note: The single highest-value key in the system. Everything agentic depends on it.

keys.label: ElevenLabs
keys.cost_detail: Free tier is enough to try it. Voice generation is metered by characters.
keys.note: Jarvis LISTENS for free using the browser speech engine. This key only makes it SPEAK.

keys.label: OpenAI (platform, NOT ChatGPT Plus)
keys.cost_detail: The OpenAI API is prepaid and COMPLETELY SEPARATE from ChatGPT Plus. Paying for ChatGPT does not fund the API. An 'insufficient_quota' error means an empty API credit balance, not a broken tool. Add credit at platform.openai.com > Settings > Billing. $5 goes a long way at four cents an image.

keys.label: Indexceptional (email)
keys.cost_detail: Submits published URLs to search engines for faster indexing. Pairs with INDEXCEPTIONAL_APP_PASSWORD.
keys.note: The step that closes the loop on a publishing pipeline. Without it you publish and wait.

keys.label: Indexceptional (app password)
keys.note: An app password, not your account password.

keys.label: DataForSEO login (email)
keys.cost_detail: Billed per lookup rather than a monthly subscription.
keys.note: Pairs with DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD. Both are needed.

destinations.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN
destinations.evidence: OpenSEO is a separate project not bundled with the pack, so this cannot be verified from the pack source

keys.label: DataForSEO password
keys.cost_detail: Billed per lookup rather than a monthly subscription.

destinations.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
destinations.evidence: OpenSEO is a separate project not bundled with the pack, so this cannot be verified from the pack source

keys.label: DeepSeek
keys.cost_detail: DeepSeek's official API. Fast and among the cheapest per token of any hosted coding model.

keys.label: Z.ai GLM
keys.note: The GLM tab also accepts ZAI_API_KEY or Z_AI_API_KEY as aliases for the same value.

keys.label: Sakana Fugu
keys.cost_detail: Claimed comparable output to Fusion at roughly a quarter of the cost. Worth it only if you run high-volume verification loops.
unlocks: Fugu model council, an alternative judge for Loop

keys.label: Router9
unlocks: an additional Free Claude Code provider

destinations.name: router9Key
destinations.evidence: referenced alongside ~/.agentic-os/fcc.json; field name not confirmed, verify in the tab

keys.label: YouTube Data API
keys.note: Astros works keyless by default using channel RSS. Only add this if you hit limits.

destinations.name: YT_API_KEY
destinations.evidence: src/app/api/astros/config/route.ts:32 reads process.env.YT_API_KEY only; the astros config.json holds channels and keywords, not the key

keys.label: SerpApi
keys.note: Not required. SEO Research works on your own Search Console data alone.

destinations.name: SERPAPI_KEY
destinations.evidence: src/components/SEOView.tsx:490 documents it as an env var only

keys.label: Ollama Cloud
keys.note: Only for the CLOUD models. Local Ollama needs no key at all.

destinations.name: OLLAMA_API_KEY
destinations.evidence: src/lib/glmcode.ts:39 forwards process.env.OLLAMA_API_KEY; no file is read

keys.label: xAI (Grok API)
unlocks: Grok via API rather than the CLI login
keys.note: Grok Build uses your X Premium+ login instead. Only needed for direct API access.

destinations.name: XAI_API_KEY
destinations.evidence: read from process.env only; no file is consulted

keys.label: OmniRoute (optional)
keys.note: OmniRoute works with no key at all. This only raises limits.

keys.label: HeyGen
keys.note: HeyGen's own interface is better than this tab, which adds a text box. Buy it directly if you want AI avatars.

keys.label: Suno (via a provider such as sunoapi.org)
Hunter.io
keys.note: Finds names and addresses, then stops. No sequencing, tracking or deliverability. Only worth it as a feeder into a real CRM.

destinations.name: hunterKey
destinations.evidence: src/lib/outreachConfig.ts:13 CONFIG_FILE, getHunterKey() reads cfg.hunterKey first

keys.label: Firecrawl
keys.note: Bills per crawl and adds up fast if left running across large lists.

blocked.why: The Claude tab authenticates with 'claude login' (browser OAuth) against your Claude plan. Setting this key at all switches you to pay-per-token. Setting it EMPTY silently overrides your login and breaks the tab entirely. keys.sh refuses to write it.

no_key_needed.note: Agent Factory, Game Studio, Agent Kanban. Free forever, nothing leaves your machine.
Keyless tier reads channel RSS. Works day one.
Browser speech recognition. Chrome or Safari.
Search Console OAuth, read-only, no API key
Ships built in, nothing to configure

formats.env: KEY=value line in a file the tool reads
formats.json: a named field inside a JSON config the tool reads
formats.env-only: the tool reads this ONLY from the process environment. No file is consulted, so it must be exported before the dashboard starts.
